name: GitHub Command Center
description: Git for KiCad projects: visual diffs, commit, pull and push, and generated README, BOM, gerber, STEP and render files.
description_full:
A Git front-end for the KiCad PCB editor.

- Version control: commit with per-file selection, branches, stashes, tags, push, pull and force download. Notifies when the server has newer commits.
- Visual diff: schematic and PCB changes between any two versions in a shareable HTML file, with per-layer, overlay and swipe views and optional DRC/ERC and netlist comparison.
- Outputs, on commit or on demand: README hardware summary, BOM files, gerber and drill ZIP, 3D STEP model, board renders and schematic SVGs. Settings are stored per project.
- Team sharing: bundles personal symbol, footprint and 3D model libraries into the project.
- JLCPCB design-rule constraints in one click.

Requires Git on the system PATH. Board rendering needs KiCad 9.0+.
